major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use this on cooldown as often as you can to smooth your damage intake, and hold it only briefly to line up with an incoming damage spike.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table marks 31884 as NOT observed in the sampled casts, but it is the guide's named button for this cooldown, used repeatedly in the priority list and the opener; no alternate id is offered.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use this on cooldown as much as possible, preferably while Avenging Wrath is active and while you are at or near 0 Holy Power.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Bulwark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On the Lightsmith build, spend a charge whenever you have one available instead of banking it.

major_cooldowns.name: Sacred Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On the Lightsmith build, cast this while you are not inside Avenging Wrath so the buff is ready before your next burst window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 432472 is the cast id; 432502 is the same-named self-aura it applies.

defensives.name: Ardent Defender
defensives.usage_rule: Save this as your biggest damage reduction cooldown and use it during the most dangerous period of a pull or encounter.

defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Use this as your emergency immunity to survive a hit or shed a debuff that would otherwise kill you.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings
defensives.usage_rule: Cycle this defensive actively during a high damage intake period instead of saving it only for the single worst moment.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Blessing of Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Cycle this defensive actively on yourself or an ally during a high damage intake period.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
defensives.usage_rule: Cycle this defensive actively during a high damage intake period to share incoming damage with yourself.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Lay on Hands
defensives.usage_rule: Use this as a large emergency heal during a high damage intake period when you need to survive right now.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

rules.description: Open Avenger's Shield into Avenging Wrath then Divine Toll
rules.action: Pull with Avenger's Shield, then Avenging Wrath, then Divine Toll before falling into your normal rotation.

rules.description: Spend Shield of the Righteous at 3-5 Holy Power
rules.action: Spend Holy Power on Shield of the Righteous once you are in its target range or the cast is free, rather than sitting on Holy Power.
Refresh Consecration as soon as it drops instead of letting the ground effect lapse.
On the Lightsmith build, cast Sacred Weapon while Avenging Wrath is down, not while it is active.
